messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 - GPU capacity + autoscaler issues detected. High 429 rate and growing request queue for model-serving hotpaths. Pager -> oncall-jen. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-saturation

oncall-jen: Ack. I’m on it. Seeing steady queue growth on hotpath pool (x3 baseline). Latency spikes and 429s across multiple customer routes. Initial hypothesis: autoscaler not adding nodes, hitting configured max_nodes.

sre-matt: Jumping in — pulling autoscaler logs now. Looks like controller heartbeats to scale-manager are delayed (many `heartbeat timeout` entries). Also seeing 503s from k8s API when autoscaler tries to create nodeclaims.

infra-lucas: I’m checking control plane limits. Kube-apiserver metrics show burst QPS throttling for serviceAccount=autoscaler-sa. There’s a per-service rate-plan applied at the gateway layer that limits write bursts.

eng-ayan: Noticed something odd in the rateplan mapping — internal autoscaler traffic is being classified under the 'standard' rate-tier instead of 'service-control' (which has higher burst allowance). Likely config drift from the routing change last week. Also the token refill window is 60s, which is too coarse for autoscaler heartbeat patterns.

oncall-jen: Good find. That would explain 'heartbeat delayed -> can’t request new nodes -> queue grows'. Can someone confirm which routing rule changed?

infra-lucas: Found PR #8421 last Wednesday altered header-based routing. The autoscaler service lost the special header mapping when the deploy hit canary. Rolling back mapping would be disruptive; prefer to patch rateplan mapping for autoscaler-sa.

eng-ayan: Suggestion: temporarily bump the autoscaler’s rate-tier to `high-burst` and shorten token refill window to 10s. This should allow immediate heartbeats and nodeclaim creation. I’ll prepare the patch.

oncall-jen: Ok apply patch and monitor. Also open customer-facing notes for now.

eng-ayan: Applying config patch to gateway:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://gateway.internal/configs/rateplan/patch" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"serviceAccount":"autoscaler-sa","rateTier":"high-burst","refillWindowSecs":10}'
```

eng-ayan: Patch returned 202. Restarting gateway-worker for mapping reload.

infra-lucas: Gateway worker restarted on region-us-east-1. Observability: apiserver write throttles dropping.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Auto-check: 429 rate for hotpath down 78% (from ~3200/min -> ~700/min) in the last 3m. Queue length decreasing.

oncall-jen: Running a manual scale test to confirm autoscaler can now create nodes.

sre-matt: Autoscaler log tail:
```text
[08:12:05] heartbeat ok
[08:12:07] create nodeclaim request id=nc-8fa2 -> accepted
[08:12:08] nodeclaim nc-8fa2 bound to gpu-node-66
```

incident-bot: :information_source: Metric check: node additions observed +3 nodes in pool-hotpath within 5m. P50 latency returning toward baseline.

support-kim: Notifying affected customers: ABC-Maps and ChattyApp. Filed incident tickets INC-11234 and INC-11235. Both teams saw elevated latencies and 429s — they’re being updated.

oncall-jen: Mitigation seems effective. Next steps: (1) revert temporary high-burst after traffic normalizes and schedule a targeted routing fix for header mapping; (2) reduce blast radius by adding an explicit autoscaler header in the client; (3) postmortem. Who can own the routing fix?

infra-lucas: I’ll own the routing fix. Plan: revert the header-based rule PR and reintroduce a safe rollout with extra tests for autoscaler SA. Target ETA 3h.

eng-ayan: I’ll add a policy test in the CI that asserts autoscaler SA maps to service-control/high-burst tier and that refillWindow < 15s for heartbeats.

sre-matt: Runbook update: add section for "rate-tier mismatch causing autoscaler stall" and include quick patch snippet (the curl above).

oncall-jen: Handoff summary for next shift: current status: stabilized, 429s reduced, queue draining, +3 nodes added. Owner (routing fix): infra-lucas. CI test: eng-ayan. Support follow-ups: support-kim. Oncall continuing until handoff at 10:00.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident flagged as mitigated. Escalation level downgraded from P0 to P1 for routing fix work and postmortem.

support-kim: Logged customer impact notes and next customer update scheduled in 60m.

oncall-jen: Thanks team. I’ll leave a runbook checkpoint in the incident doc and hand off to infra-lucas for the routing fix. Please add any missing items to the incident doc. :thumbsup:
